body:
Review pass 35. A ceiling bound for Epic 8, plus a correction to my own method.

METHOD CORRECTION FIRST. I started measuring the dense-metric ceiling by shrinking active_slices and extrapolating linearly in node count. That design is invalid and I caught it before publishing a number. Reducing slices TRUNCATES the searchlights, so support size moves with node count:

  slices= 1  nodes= 2184  mean k=12.6   (k/k_full)^3 = 0.055
  slices= 2  nodes= 4368  mean k=21.3   0.269
  slices= 3  nodes= 6552  mean k=24.9   0.429
  slices= 8  nodes=17472  mean k=29.4   0.705
  slices=24  nodes=52416  mean k=31.2   0.842

The dominant per-support cost is a k-by-k solve, so roughly k^3. Extrapolating from a 1-slice fixture would have understated per-node cost by ~18x and produced a wildly optimistic ceiling. Discarded. Any ceiling measurement must hold k fixed or normalise by k^3.

BOUND THAT NEEDS NO NEW COMPUTATION - the gate IS the measurement. At 52416 nodes, mean k = 31.2, it has consumed over 45 minutes without finishing. Holding k fixed, cost is near-linear in nodes, so a 30-minute budget corresponds to at most

  52416 * 30/45 = 34944 nodes

and since the run has not finished the true value is lower. Supported dense-metric ceiling at this support size is BELOW about 35000 nodes - a generous upper bound, not an estimate.

WHY I AM NOT MEASURING MORE PRECISELY YET: the gate worker is saturating a core, so timings taken now would measure the machine rather than the code - the same class of error as the bad extrapolation. The precise ceiling wants a quiet machine, active_slices held at 24 with reduced in-plane extent so k stays near 31, at two or three node counts.

EPIC 8 DOES NOT NEED THE EXACT NUMBER TO CLOSE WELL. This is already a usable scope statement:
  brain-scale diagonal / identity metrics SUPPORTED - 52k voxels, 166 s end to end
  dense local metrics NOT SUPPORTED at whole-brain node counts - ceiling below ~35000 nodes at
  support size ~31, exact boundary to be pinned on a quiet machine

Still open and unchanged: bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX (MC test 1% headroom) and bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50 (measurement-kernel preflight allocates what it sizes - now clearly relevant given this path is runtime-bound).
